extracted.intended_audience: researchers and potential peer reviewers for Springer Nature journals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance page directing researchers to Springer Nature's peer-review tutorial and to journal-specific instructions on how to evaluate manuscripts, understand peer-review types, and how to be considered as a reviewer for Springer Nature titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Springer Nature tutorial 'How to Peer Review' covers manuscript evaluation as a core topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points reviewers to the tutorial for 'valuable insights into the peer review process' including manuscript evaluation; no specific evaluation checklist is provided on this page — reviewers are directed to the tutorial for detailed guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding different peer review types
rubrics_metrics.description: The tutorial covers understanding different peer review types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page notes that the tutorial explains various peer review types; for specifics (e.g., single-blind, double-blind, open review) reviewers should consult the tutorial or the journal-specific guidance linked below.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal-specific peer-reviewer information
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult journal-specific guidance pages for details applicable to particular titles (BMC journals, Springer titles, Nature journals, Nature-titled journals, other Nature-branded titles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs reviewers to specific locations: 'Information for BMC Series reviewers' for BMC journals; 'How to peer review' for Springer titles; 'For Referees' from a Nature journal's homepage for Nature journal only; 'For Reviewers' or 'For Authors & Referees' links on journal homepages for other Nature-titled/brand journals. Reviewers should follow the linked, journal-specific instructions for policies, expectations, and any journal-specific criteria or formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to be considered as a peer reviewer at Springer Nature
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on becoming a peer reviewer for Springer Nature is available via a dedicated page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to 'How to be considered as a peer reviewer at Springer Nature?' for instructions on becoming a reviewer — consult that page for any eligibility criteria, registration steps, and expectations for prospective reviewers.
